Team — attaching a short redline to the Order Form (Nimbus-OrderForm-v3_redline.pdf). Key points from legal: 

1) Publicity scope: Accept narrow right to use Customer's name and logo as a reference (website, marketing materials, case study).
2) Approval process: Any press release or public announcement referencing the customer requires mutual written approval; customer to respond within 10 business days of receiving a draft. If no response in 10 business days, approval is deemed granted unless objected in writing. (We can shorten/lengthen window if business requests.)
3) Confidentiality carveout: We will include a standard carveout allowing Redwood to reference the existence of the relationship and high-level, non-sensitive metrics ("pilot completed with X users" or "reduction in latency"), but metrics that include customer data or proprietary figures must be anonymized or redacted.
4) Logo use: Insert requirement that logo use follow customer brand guidelines and that Redwood will provide a single mockup for approval (no more than 2 rounds of edits).
5) No unlimited sublicensing: carve language preventing downstream transfer of logo rights to third parties without customer consent.
6) Mutuality: add reciprocal sentence allowing the customer to reference Redwood similarly for consistency.

Open items for negotiation: the deemed approval after 10 business days (Amy — is that acceptable?) and whether Nimbus wants a publication embargo tied to the pilot completion date.

I recommend we accept the publicity clause with the above protections and push the Order Form to signature, then follow up on any embargo specifics in a separate comms thread.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Amy — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Jacob in. Per Monica's redline, we have the following agreed process: 

- Publicity: Nimbus grants Redwood the limited right to use Nimbus' name and logo as a customer reference for marketing, website, and case studies.
- Approval: Redwood will send any press release or announcement draft to Nimbus; Nimbus will respond within 10 business days. If Nimbus does not respond within 10 business days, approval is deemed granted.
- Confidentiality: Redwood will only reference high-level, non-sensitive pilot metrics in public materials unless specific metrics are approved by Nimbus in writing.
- Logo usage: Redwood will follow Nimbus' brand guidelines and provide a single mockup for approval (two rounds of edits max).

Ben and marketing will prepare the co-branded announcement and share a draft by next Tue. Monica — please keep the redline we discussed in place and I'll ask ops to attach the redline to the signed Order Form.
